Settings.ConnectionMethodDescription: Choose how prompt processing connects to OpenAI. API key uses the OpenAI API; ChatGPT login reuses an existing ChatGPT subscription.
Settings.ApiKeyDescription: Stored securely and used for OpenAI transcription, LLM, and TTS requests. Required for transcription and text-to-speech even in ChatGPT login mode.
Settings.LlmModelDescriptionChatGpt: ChatGPT login mode uses the supported ChatGPT model list for prompt processing.
Settings.LlmModelDescriptionFetched: Showing {0} OpenAI LLM model(s) fetched from the API.
Settings.LlmModelDescriptionDefault: Using the default OpenAI model list. Click Validate to test the key and fetch current models.
Settings.ReasoningEffortDescription: Reasoning effort for GPT-5, o-series, and Codex models.
Settings.TemperatureDescription: Provider Default uses the recommended value (0.3) for each model. Custom lets you pick a value below. Only used when the model supports temperature (no GPT-5 + reasoning).
Settings.TemperatureValueDescription: Sampling temperature 0.0–2.0. Applied when Temperature is set to Custom. Ignored on models that don't accept the field (e.g. GPT-5 with reasoning).
Settings.StreamResponsesDescription: Render prompt-action and cleanup output token-by-token as the model generates it, instead of waiting for the full reply. Applies to the chat-completions models; reasoning models fall back to a single render.
Settings.VoiceInstructionsDescription: Optional. Style guidance applied to the text-to-speech voice.
Settings.ForgetChatGptLoginDescription: When set, the next Validate removes the stored ChatGPT login.
Settings.ApiKeyValidFetched: API key is valid. Fetched {0} OpenAI LLM model(s).
Settings.ApiKeyValidDefault: API key is valid. Using saved/default models.
Settings.ChatGptLoginRefreshFailed: Stored ChatGPT login could not be refreshed: {0} Enable "Forget ChatGPT login" and re-run Validate to clear the stored credentials, then sign in again.
Settings.ChatGptImportFailed: Could not import existing ChatGPT login: {0}
Settings.ChatGptLoginPortInUse: Could not start the login listener on port 1455. Close any application using that port and try again.
Settings.ChatGptLoginNoBrowser: Could not open a browser for ChatGPT login. Install xdg-utils or set a default browser and try again. ({0})
Manifest.Name: OpenAI / ChatGPT
Manifest.Description: OpenAI transcription, ChatGPT/OpenAI prompt processing, and text-to-speech. Use an API key for STT/TTS or ChatGPT login for prompts.
